scope.purpose: Post-feasibility engineering adjudication of whether exact-grid filtering plus exact original-pair fallback makes the prior-reference bank sufficiently representative for a separate label-free score extraction.
scope.sensor: Sentinel-2 only; Landsat remains exact champion identity

known_before_freeze: The original preregistered audit formally failed its all-rows exact-grid-equivalence gate.
14,569 of 14,963 Sentinel-2 rows have at least one selected exact-grid reference.
13,733 Sentinel-2 rows have five selected references.
112 rows have a same-key strictly prior clear candidate but no exact-grid candidate.
No label, mask, model score, prediction, external held outcome, or official-test outcome was opened by that audit.
timing_disclosure.interpretation: These known quantities are engineering coverage facts, not methane outcomes. The original FAIL remains immutable; this document defines a narrower fallback-aware authorization before model inference.

gates.pass_action: Authorize only a separately preregistered, label-free alternate-reference score extraction on folds 3/4 with exact original-pair fallback.
gates.failure_action: Stop the reference-set path before model inference.

tests.result: 7 focused reference-bank and adjudication tests passed before adjudication

invariants: The original FAIL result is preserved and never rewritten.
Only the compact initial audit and its ignored label-free selection manifest are read.
No label, plume mask, flux, model score, prediction, checkpoint, fold 2, folds 0/1, external held outcome, or official-test outcome is accessed.
Every alternate reference remains exact-grid by the frozen builder contract; uncovered rows use the original MARS pair exactly.
Passing is not evidence of methane performance and cannot promote an architecture.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only that the already-built exact-grid bank is sufficiently representative for a separate label-free inference diagnostic with explicit fallback. It does not establish complementarity, improvement, calibration, generalization, or superiority.
